_comment: Per-file routes for the installer downloads, injected by scripts/inject_installer_headers.mjs.
SEPARATE FROM vercel.json ON PURPOSE: scripts/inject_headers.mjs is a byte-identical copy of
WebForge's canonical tool and aborts on any source other than '/(.*)'. Adding these to
vercel.json aborts the whole deploy (verified, not assumed).
/install.ps1 as text/plain is LOAD-BEARING: Windows PowerShell 5.1 returns Invoke-WebRequest
.Content as a byte[] for application/octet-stream, so `irm ... | iex` receives a list of
character codes and dies. Observed on a real Windows 11 box.
